Landing.featuresTitle: Indian business ke everyday billing work ke liye tools

Help.title: Business confidence ke saath chalayein.
Help.subtitle: Billing, GST fields, Khata, records aur Copilot privacy ke practical answers ek jagah.
Help.supportDescription: Agar workflow expected tarah se kaam na kare, screen, kiya gaya action aur error reference bhejein. Passwords ya API keys kabhi share na karein.
Help.gettingStartedBody: Pehle business profile complete karein, phir products aur customers add karke pehla invoice banayein.
Help.gettingStartedOne: Invoice par print hone wali legal/business details add karein.
Help.gettingStartedTwo: Price, GST rate, stock aur optional SKU/HSN ke saath products banayein.
Help.gettingStartedThree: Customer select karke invoice save karne se pehle har detail review karein.
Help.invoicesBody: BillForge final save se pehle customer, GST, stock aur payment details review karne deta hai.
Help.invoicesOne: Cash, UPI aur paid modes invoice payments ke liye hain; credit sale ke liye customer-linked Khata use karein.
Help.invoicesTwo: Invoice save hone se pehle server product price, GST, stock aur total dobara calculate karta hai.
Help.invoicesThree: Cancelled invoices audit history mein rehte hain aur active totals mein include nahi hote.
Help.khataBody: Positive balance ka matlab customer ko business ko payment deni hai. Negative balance customer ka advance ya credit hai.
Help.khataOne: Credit sale ko sale entry aur collection ko payment entry ke roop mein record karein. Paid credit sale cancel karne par received amount customer credit ke roop mein rehta hai jab tak aap usse separately settle na karein.
Help.khataTwo: Customer statement se transaction timeline aur running balance dekhein.
Help.khataThree: Khata reset related active invoices archive, active entries cancel aur reset audit record karta hai; customer ya product catalog delete nahi karta.
Help.gstBody: GST treatment business aur customer ke state relationship aur product GST rate se calculate hota hai.
Help.gstOne: Same-state invoice mein CGST aur SGST; inter-state invoice mein IGST use hota hai.
Help.gstTwo: Product prices aur GST server par recheck hote hain; unexpected total review screen par check karein.
Help.gstThree: Jab workflow mein zarurat ho, products mein HSN ya SKU add karein.
Help.copilotBody: Copilot read-only assistant hai. Question poochne par bounded, tenant-scoped summary read karta hai aur records create, edit, cancel ya delete nahi kar sakta.
Help.copilotOne: Context mein 30-day aggregate aur limited recent invoice, receivable, low-stock aur product-sales rows hote hain.
Help.copilotTwo: Answer source invoice, customer ledger ya product record open karne ka replacement nahi hai.
Help.copilotThree: Provider ya database unavailable ho to BillForge number estimate karne ke bajaye error dikhata hai.
Help.privacyBody: Workspace credentials private rakhein. Problem report karte waqt visible error reference use karein.
Help.privacyOne: Settings mein tenant-scoped workspace backup available hai. Account deletion abhi self-service action nahi hai.
Help.privacyTwo: Save request timeout ho to duplicate action se bachne ke liye relevant list refresh karke retry karein.
Help.privacyThree: Destructive action se pehle impact summary padhein aur confirmation phrase exact type karein.
